# Waddat Drinks

> Waddat Drinks is a beverage brand crafting authentic Jamaican-inspired bottled fruit drinks and sea moss tonics. Rooted in Caribbean family heritage, our recipes use natural ingredients, real fruits, citrus, herbs, and spices, with zero artificial preservatives.

Waddat Drinks brings traditional Caribbean refreshment to modern lifestyles. From bold Ginger and spiced Sorrel to refreshing Lemonade, Pineapple Sea Moss, and Soursop Sea Moss tonics, every drink is made with recipes inspired by Jamaican family heritage.

## Product Range

- [Ginger](https://waddatdrinks.com/product/ginger/): Bold warmth of real ginger paired with bright lemon and a mellow touch of honey.
- [Sorrel](https://waddatdrinks.com/product/sorrel-drink/): Lively twist on a Jamaican favourite with tangy sorrel (hibiscus), warming ginger, and bright lemon. Sweet, tart, and spiced.
- [Lemonade](https://waddatdrinks.com/product/Lemonade/): Vibrant island lemonade pairing the lively tang of lemon with mellow honey.
- [Pineapple Sea Moss](https://waddatdrinks.com/product/Pineapple-Sea-Moss/): Tropical pineapple sweetness blended with ocean-harvested sea moss, lemon, and honey for a smooth, refreshing drink.
- [Soursop Sea Moss](https://waddatdrinks.com/product/Soursop-Sea-Moss/): Mellow tropical sweetness of real soursop paired with sea moss, lifted by bright lemon and honey.

## Key Product Information

- Natural ingredients: real ginger root, sorrel (hibiscus flowers), real lemons, pineapple juice, soursop fruit, and wildcrafted sea moss
- Naturally sweetened with honey or raw cane sugar depending on the recipe
- Ready to drink in 330ml bottles; best enjoyed chilled (shake well before drinking)
- Free from artificial preservatives, artificial colors, and synthetic flavorings
- Vegan friendly options (Sorrel) and honey-sweetened varieties (Ginger, Lemonade, Pineapple Sea Moss, Soursop Sea Moss)
